_doc: NVIDIA Build/NIM capability matrix. Method: LIVE single-shot probes on our own API key (not model-card theory) with per-model timeout. RE-VALIDATED 2026-07-17 (10 days after the 2026-07-07 baseline) — the endpoint drifted HARD: 4 of 6 role-models broke. kimi-k2.6 -> HTTP 404 (gone), mistral-large-3-675b -> HANGS >22s, gpt-oss-120b -> EMPTY content via our text adapter, llama-4-maverick -> HANGS >22s. Only minimax-m3 (default) and nemotron-3-nano (fast) survived. Replacements were found by probing the live 119-model catalog with a real coding prompt: nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b (coding), deepseek-v4-flash (reasoning; it ERRORED on 07-07 but RECOVERED), mistral-small-4-119b-2603 (review). deepseek-v4-PRO still HANGS — only FLASH is safe. NVIDIA is called SINGLE-SHOT as a tool (not the agent runtime), so raw quality + a non-hanging clean response is what counts. Lead/Boss ALWAYS runs on Claude Opus 4.8. RE-PROBE before trusting after ~1 week: models come and go on this endpoint.

premiumFallback.when: Lead/Boss ALWAYS Opus 4.8. High-risk reasoning, architecture, deep code review, final QA, security, complex planning, AND all real vision/screenshot analysis (adapter is text-only) -> Claude. Sonnet 5 is the price/performance fallback; Opus 4.8 is accuracy-first. NVIDIA reduces cost on bulk in-task work; it never replaces a premium assignment and never handles the final verdict.

honesty: Every model here carries a LIVE-probe result from 2026-07-17 on our own key (per-model timeout). The 2026-07-07 matrix was 4/6 stale within 10 days — model cards and benchmarks did NOT predict which models hang, 404, or return empty on this endpoint. Re-probe with a real chat call (see .claude/forge-bin/nvidia-provider.cjs) after ~1 week before trusting any entry.
